results.title: NCCE engages women’s groups on rule of law and anti-corruption
results.content: The National Commission for Civic Education (NCCE) in the Krachi East Municipality has organised a follow-up civic engagement with women's groups to strengthen public understanding of the rule of law, accountability and the fight against corruption.

results.title: Sandra Amarquaye wins PR Professional Practitioner of the Year at IPR Excellence Awards 2025
results.content: Sandra Amarquaye, Corporate Communications Manager at Karpowership Ghana Company Limited (KGCL), was named PR Professional Practitioner of the Year at the 2025 Institute of Public Relations (IPR) Ghana Excellence Awards.

results.title: NDC cancels constituency election in Amenfi East
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has cancelled its constituency-level election in Amenfi East in the Western Region following challenges during the party’s nationwide internal polls.

results.title: Jerry Ahmed Shaib urges safe contraflow, seeks Metro Mass buses for Weija-Gbawe
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Weija-Gbawe, Jerry Ahmed Shaib, has called on the Ministry of Transport to extend the provision of Metro Mass Transit buses to his constituency to help address persistent transport challenges.

results.title: Gender advocate urges sustained breast cancer education in rural Ghana
results.content: Ghanaian media personality and US-based healthcare professional, Josephine Oppong-Yeboah has urged the Ghana Health Service (GHS) to intensify breast cancer education and outreach programmes, particularly among women in rural communities. She said myths and misconceptions about the disease had contributed to delays in seeking medical care, resulting in preventable deaths.

results.title: Roads Ministry wins PR Organisation of the Year for the second time
results.content: The Ministry of Roads and Highways has won the Public Sector PR Organisation of the Year award for the second consecutive time at the Institute of Public Relations (IPR) Ghana Excellence Awards.

results.title: Government grateful to Benin, Togo, international partners for swift rescue of fishers
results.content: Government has expressed sincere appreciation to the governments of Togo and Benin, and key international maritime partners, for coordinating the rescue of the seven Fishers.

results.title: EC yet to announce Dormaa Central NDC constituency election results
results.content: The Dormaa Central Electoral Commission (EC) in the Bono Region is yet to declare the winners of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) election in the constituency.

results.title: Benjamin Djakumah retains NDC Tema Central chairmanship
results.content: Benjamin Djakumah has retained the Tema Central Constituency chairmanship of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), polling 685 votes in the party’s constituency executive elections.

results.title: Julius Nainoo unseats incumbent NDC constituency chairman in Berekum West
results.content: Delegates of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Berekum West Constituency of the Bono Region have elected Mr Julius Nainoo as party chairman.

results.title: Vice President commends Black Maidens for reaching FIFA U-17 World Cup Last 16
results.content: Vice President Prof. Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang has congratulated Ghana’s Black Maidens on reaching the Round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco after their impressive 2-0 victory over Canada.

results.title: Rapper Nicki Minaj joins Trump onstage at Michigan rally
results.content: Rapper Nicki Minaj said US President Donald Trump has "changed the energy of the country" as she joined him at a Michigan rally to stump for Republicans ahead of the nationwide midterm elections.

results.title: Libya summons US envoy to protest Trump’s remarks
results.content: Libya's foreign ministry summoned the US chargé d'affaires on ​Sunday to protest against rally statements by ‌President Donald Trump it described as "offensive", after he called the North African nation "terror-infested".

results.title: We do not support our own, but we watch horrible Hollywood movies – Yvonne Okoro
results.content: Ghanaian actor and film producer Yvonne Okoro has bemoaned the lack of support for local films

results.title: Ghana loses GH¢209.7m to cyber incidents in nine months – CSA
results.content: Ghana recorded an estimated GH¢209.7 million in losses from reported cybersecurity incidents between January and September 2026, the Director-General of the Cyber Security Authority (CSA), Dr Divine Selasi Agbeti, has disclosed.

results.title: Accept results, close ranks – Asiedu Nketiah urges NDC aspirants
results.content: The National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, has urged aspirants in the party’s constituency executive elections to accept the results and unite after the contest.

results.title: South Africa to allow fund managers 100% foreign assets under new framework
results.content: South African fund managers will be able to hold 100% of portfolios in foreign assets under ring-fenced mandates, regulators said on ​Friday, in a new framework that exempts qualifying vehicles from a ‌longstanding 45% offshore investment cap.

results.title: ‘I visit Ozzy’s grave every day’ – Sharon Osbourne
results.content: It's been 15 months since Ozzy Osbourne died at the age of 76, at his home in Buckinghamshire.

results.title: Kojo Kwarteng: From journalism and corporate communications to law
results.content: On Friday, October 9, 2026, Emmanuel Kojo Kwarteng became a lawyer, adding the legal profession to a diverse career spanning journalism, marketing, corporate communications, public relations, banking, authorship, alternative dispute resolution (ADR) and community service

results.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
results.content: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has returned home to a fraught political landscape after more than 10 months in exile.

results.title: Gov’t bills face bipartisan scrutiny, not Parliament’s Finance Committee chairman’s orders – Adongo
results.content: Parliament’s Finance Committee Chairman, Isaac Adongo, says government bills undergo bipartisan scrutiny, with committee members shaping decisions rather than his personal instructions.

results.title: Northern Region NDC urges unity after internal polls, eyes 2028 victory
results.content: The Northern Regional Secretariat of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) has urged newly elected officers and unsuccessful candidates to close ranks after the party’s branch and constituency elections across the region.

results.title: U/W Regional Chief Imam’s education fund supports 61 students with GH¢138,536
results.content: The Upper West Regional Chief Imam Educational Endowment Fund has disbursed GH¢138,536 to support 61 academically promising but financially disadvantaged students pursuing tertiary education nationwide.

results.title: Adongo defends GoldBod law’s passage despite opposition concerns, leaves door open to review
results.content: Parliament’s Finance Committee Chairman, Isaac Adongo, has defended the passage of the law establishing GoldBod despite opposition concerns about some provisions. He says the law can be reviewed if lapses emerge.

results.title: ‘Replace complexity with compassion’ – Cardinal Turkson urges students
results.content: The Chancellor of the Catholic University of Ghana, Cardinal Peter Appiah Turkson, has urged students to embrace compassion and collective responsibility as they prepare for a world shaped by conflict, technological disruption and uncertainty.

results.title: Foreign participation in capital market strengthens considerably in half-year 2026
results.content: The improvement was on the back of the issuance of the new bonds amidst improved macroeconomic conditions and financial market prospects.

results.title: Parliament’s Finance Committee has had no reason to worry over government bills – Adongo
results.content: Parliament’s Finance Committee Chairman, Isaac Adongo, says the committee has had no reason to worry about government bills brought before it, citing bipartisan scrutiny and broad agreement among members.

results.title: Oil slips from near six-month highs despite supply concerns
results.content: Oil prices fell on Monday ​after surging to near six-month highs ‌late last week, although ongoing attacks on Saudi Arabia kept supply concerns in ​focus.

results.title: Senegal party that controls parliament comes out against revised budget bill
results.content: Senegal's Pastef party, which holds a large majority in the National Assembly, said it would not pass the government's ​revised budget, reinforcing doubts over how quickly the country ‌can push ahead with its debt restructuring,

results.title: Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says
results.content: Genomic ​analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case ‌shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister ​Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering ​the first genetic link between the outbreaks.
